rule: Humanised db_id (underscores to spaces, trailing numeric suffix removed) followed by the first five Spider questions for that database in dataset order. Databases with no questions in the distributed dataset receive the db_id sentence alone and are flagged.
questionSource: xlangai/spider train and validation splits via the Hugging Face datasets-server rows endpoint

descriptions.description: Design the database schema for academic.

Design the database schema for activity. The system must be able to answer questions such as: How many faculty do we have? What is the total number of faculty members? What ranks do we have for faculty? Find the list of distinct ranks for faculty. Show all the distinct buildings that have faculty rooms.

Design the database schema for aircraft. The system must be able to answer questions such as: How many aircrafts are there? What is the number of aircraft? List the description of all aircrafts. What are the descriptions for the aircrafts? What is the average number of international passengers of all airports?

Design the database schema for allergy. The system must be able to answer questions such as: How many allergies are there? How many allergy entries are there? How many different allergy types exist? How many distinct allergies are there? Show all allergy types.

Show the start dates and end dates of all the apartment bookings. What are the start date and end date of each apartment booking? Show all distinct building descriptions.
